fullPlan.breakfast: 8:00 AM – 8:45 AM: High-protein meal. Choose: 2 Oats/Moong dal dosas with tomato chutney, OR vegetable sprout salad with lemon, OR 2 boiled egg whites + 1 whole wheat toast + green tea.
fullPlan.midMorning: 11:00 AM: 1 seasonal fruit (apple, guava, papaya, or pear) OR tender coconut water. Avoid high-sugar mango/banana during initial fat burn phase.
fullPlan.lunch: 1:00 PM – 1:45 PM: Half plate filled with fresh raw salad (cucumber, carrot, radish). 1 bowl mixed vegetable sabzi cooked in cold-pressed oil, 1 bowl thick dal/rajma, and 1-2 small multigrain rotis or 1 small cup red rice.
fullPlan.postLunch: 30 mins after lunch: 1 glass homemade buttermilk with crushed roasted cumin and ginger.
fullPlan.eveningSnack: 4:30 PM – 5:15 PM: 1 cup green tea or herbal tulsi tea + 1 fistful of roasted makhana (foxnuts) or boiled peanuts or roasted chana.
fullPlan.dinner: 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Strictly finish 2.5 hours before bed): Light protein-forward dinner. Bottle gourd/spinach vegetable soup + stir-fried paneer / tofu / grilled chicken with steamed broccoli and beans.
fullPlan.bedtime: 9:45 PM: 1 glass warm turmeric water or chamomile herbal infusion.

Maintain a gap of 20 to 30 minutes between medicines and meals or hot drinks.
Avoid raw garlic, strong raw onion, and eucalyptus/camphor chewing gums within 30 minutes of taking homoeopathic remedies.
Drink at least 2.5 to 3 liters of water evenly throughout the day.

Deep-fried snacks (samosas, bajjis, packaged chips).

fullPlan.overview: Managing diabetes is not about starving; it is about controlling the glycemic load and preserving pancreatic beta-cell function through smart food pairing, resistant starch, and consistent meal timings.
fullPlan.morningWakeup: 6:30 AM: 1 glass warm water with 1 teaspoon of overnight-soaked Methi (fenugreek) seeds. Chew the softened seeds thoroughly (galactomannan fiber delays carbohydrate absorption).
fullPlan.breakfast: 8:30 AM: High protein and high soluble fiber. 2 Missi rotis (chana flour + whole wheat + chopped methi) with fresh curd, OR sprouted moong dal chilla with vegetable stuffing, OR 2 eggs with sautéed mushrooms and whole grain toast.
fullPlan.midMorning: 11:00 AM: 1 small Indian gooseberry (Amla) OR 1 small guava / green apple + 4 soaked almonds.
fullPlan.lunch: 1:00 PM: Always follow the sequential eating rule: 1) Eat the raw cucumber-tomato-radish salad FIRST; 2) Eat the bowl of dal / paneer / chicken / fish SECOND; 3) Eat the 1-2 multigrain or jowar rotis / 1 cup foxtail millet (Thinai) LAST. This blunts post-meal glucose spikes by up to 40%!
fullPlan.postLunch: Walk for 10-15 minutes briskly at normal pace to activate GLUT-4 glucose transporters in muscle tissue.
fullPlan.eveningSnack: 4:30 PM: 1 cup green tea with a dash of cinnamon powder (insulin mimetic) + 1 fistful of roasted Bengal gram (chana) or boiled sundal (sprouted legumes).
fullPlan.dinner: 7:30 PM: Early light dinner. Steamed vegetable soup + 1 small Jowar/Bajra roti with rich palak dal, OR grilled fish/tofu with stir-fried beans, carrots, and cauliflower.
fullPlan.bedtime: 9:45 PM: 1 small cup warm almond milk or turmeric water with a pinch of nutmeg (prevents overnight nocturnal glucose dips).
homoeopathyRules: Homoeopathic remedies like Syzygium Jambolanum, Gymnema Sylvestre, or Uranium Nitricum support pancreatic vitality.
Take medicines 30 minutes away from any food or tea.
Check fasting and post-prandial blood sugars weekly and maintain a written log.

Refined flour (maida), white bread, naans, bhaturas, pastries.
Deep-fried potatoes, potato chips, french fries, sweet potato in excess.
